top_items.one_line: Customer alleges a duplicate €214.60 charge and threatens a formal complaint/payment dispute unless refunded by 12 November.
Gaia Lights says its account and pending shipment will be put on hold Wednesday 11 November over an overdue €1,150 invoice.
Atlantic Tyres requests new bank details; verify independently using a known contact before changing records or paying.
School had requested 12 serviced bikes for Monday; confirm the event’s status—the later cancellation came from a lookalike sender address (x1), so don’t rely on it without verification.
Purports to cancel the school event but uses a sender domain differing by a zero; treat as suspicious and verify through the school’s established contact.
Customer reports a non-working rear light and asks for an exchange.
Customer needs the wheelset before a race on 22 November; check delivery timing and respond.
Sales reports low stock of 700x28 inner tubes and requests an order of 50.
Customer requests delivery to a different address for RC-1002; confirm the change before acting.
